messages:
anne_pm: quick review request — new threshold expression UI + suppression preview. Pushed a prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (see 'expr-builder/v2'). can we do a 5–10 min in-thread scan before the sync?
mike_design: skimmed — nice. main ask: preview pane copy feels ambiguous when multiple channels are selected. it says 'Notifies: #sales, #infra' but when suppressed it shows the same text with a grey pill. users might not tell if suppression applies per-channel or global.
kris_eng: implementation note: suppression is evaluated per-channel in backend now. UI can either show per-channel toggles or a global badge with tooltip. per-channel toggles add complexity to mobile.
maya_research: from interviews: people expect suppression to be scoped. Suggested copy: 'Suppressed for channel(s): X' and on hover list the exact scopes + time window. keeps it clear.
lee_copy: alternative microcopy options:
- 'Suppressed on: #infra (1h) — alerts will not send to this channel'
- 'Muted for #infra until 11:23am — will still appear in console'
my preference is the shorter first one.
a11y_bot: note: if you change visible text per-channel, make sure the suppression state is announced via aria-live and the pill has aria-label like 'Suppressed on channel sales until 10:00 a.m.' so screen readers don't rely on color.
mike_design: good call. Also keyboard flow: when tabbing through notification matrix, focus should land on channel pill, then status menu, then suppression toggle. currently prototype groups toggle inside the menu which is extra keystrokes. can we expose a dedicated toggle in the row?
kris_eng: exposing toggle in row is doable. but it means extra API calls per toggle unless we batch. will need to debounce.
maya_research: users preferred fewer context clicks during incidents, so dedicated toggles improve time-to-action.
lee_copy: small copy nits: 'quiet window' -> confuse some users. suggest 'snooze window' or 'temporary suppression'. which one aligns with the rest of the console text?
anne_pm: we use 'snooze' in incident workflows elsewhere. let's standardize on 'snooze window' and update docs. noted for i18n.
a11y_bot: also check contrast on the disabled pill states — current grey is 4.2:1 on light background. need 4.5:1 for small text.
mike_design: ack. I'll darken the pill and re-export contrast tokens.
kris_eng: last thing — preview should show a sample event timeline with affected SLOs and where notifications would land. can we reuse the existing sim-engine output?
maya_research: yes, real examples helped users trust changes. show 'what would happen' with a mock 5-min spike.
lee_copy: suggested one-liner for the preview header: 'Preview: simulated delivery with current notification & suppression settings' keeps it clear.
anne_pm: great. action items: mike adjust pill copy + keyboard flow, kris add debounce for toggles, a11y_bot confirm aria-live labeling, lee update copy sheet, maya add 2 interview quotes to figma. i'll follow up in the sync. thanks :thumbsup:
